spans.s: कौप [kaupa], a. (-पी f.) [कूप-अण्] Relating to or coming from a well (as water). -पम् Well-water.
कौपीनम् [kaupīnam], [कूप-खञ्; see Sk. on शालीनकौपीने अधृष्टाकार्ययोः
A small piece of cloth (usually a small strip worn over the privities; कौपीनं शतखण्डजर्जरतरं कन्था पुनस्ता- दृशी
(Hence sometimes) A ragged or tattered garment.
Sin, an improper or wrong act; नाच्छादयति कौपीनं न दंशमशकांपहम्
